purpose: Complete the generated model without rereading or reproducing duplicated authoritative artifacts.
read_plan: Read model-context.json, this contract, the evidence overview and every linked index page and evidence batch. Follow next_page until empty; no first-batch or first-N sampling.

Join fragments with the same record_id in part order through final_part=true before parsing the text as JSON. Findings retain every original attribute, statement and source/evidence locator. Wrapper provenance points to the authoritative ledger or summary.

Use in_scope only for required implementation. Review excluded findings, gaps and conflicts to avoid scope inflation. Inspect a precise ledger/summary JSON pointer only when more context is needed; do not read the whole ledger plus its summary plus the populated draft.

Read Platform-Decision.md and the applicable detailed SKILL architecture/product guidance. Use reference-index.json to select current official documentation. Per-reference excerpt batches are navigation aids, not proof of a capability. Read applicable complete official sections and record consulted IDs in assessments, gates, scores, components and topology.

Load the draft programmatically and modify targeted fields using schema slices and the checklist below. Preserve deterministic metadata, defaults and unaffected structures. The draft is not validated architecture: all provisional product choices, baseline components and unknown capabilities still require review.

completion_checklist.identity: Preserve schema_version, run_id and active research_stage. Do not author deterministic coverage percentages, counts or final complexity.
completion_checklist.requirement_assessments: Exactly one satisfied entry for EVERY in-scope finding_id, with specific capability, active-stage platform, rationale and consulted reference_ids. No unassessed tail findings or unknown IDs.
completion_checklist.platform_assessment: Apply mandatory PoC gates before category ranking. Begin with allowed Stage 1 products; assess personal delegated work with Cowork. Escalate sequentially only for persisted evidence-linked gaps. No later-stage references or products in a Stage 1 solution.
completion_checklist.delivery_assessment: Decompose all in-scope findings into atomic business capabilities; reconcile business priority/weight, dependencies, exact component_ids, implementation status/factors, allowed product/harness, treatment, owner and typed build contract. Cover every finding. Explicitly disclose simulations and replacements. Never count out-of-bound components as team-buildable.
completion_checklist.safety: Use current availability, authentication, least privilege, approved test data, safe action controls, honest simulation, auditability and a viable builder path as minimum PoC gates. Require explicit approval for high-impact/irreversible actions. Never fabricate external success, approvals, IDs or state changes. Separate production gaps from PoC blockers.
completion_checklist.components: Name exact purpose-specific products/services and preserve requirement-named external systems. Include all applicable agents, channels, skills/plugins, tools/creation methods, triggers, data, integrations, identity, security, governance, monitoring and ALM. Distinguish requirement evidence, configuration, recommendations and mandatory baselines.
completion_checklist.solution_topology: Complete canonical components, inventory mappings, hosting/ownership/implementation and environment boundaries, typed source-target relationships, trust controls, Development/Test/Production promotion, five quality decisions and architecture-derived sequences. Every inventory name maps exactly once. No generic product placeholders or hidden unsupported dependencies.
completion_checklist.sequences: At most eight lifelines and 30 interactions; actions <=56 characters, conditions <=34 and relationship labels <=42. Cover applicable auth, request/trigger, orchestration, grounding, tools/data, human decisions, monitoring/errors and responses. Ordinary cycles and async responses are legitimate; do not invent blanket acyclicity or AuthN/Response phase-order rules.
completion_checklist.global_reconciliation: Even for one changed finding, reconcile ALL assessments and weighted capabilities, cross-finding conflicts/dependencies, selected products/gates, channels/triggers, component inventory/topology/sequence, owners/build boundaries, scope and readiness gaps. Delta-only review is not sufficient.

publication: Publish only a complete model inside the run directory. The publisher revalidates the source handoff, resource/context integrity, every in-scope ID, scoring, architecture and output contracts.

Only a validated, re-scored cache candidate can skip model completion. Equivalent validated republication may reuse semantic evidence identity: ignore only the ledger's top-level run_id, preserving all other fields/dates/provenance. Keep exact current publication hashes separately bound to the run. Changed evidence, source identity, configuration, resources, references or substantive research assessments invalidate reuse; research freshness is unchanged.

A cache candidate containing old upstream artifact paths, analyzer run IDs or changed publication hashes requires fresh model completion. Check classification_cache_decision; do not blindly rewrite arbitrary provenance or prose. Current output paths and hashes are generated from the current prepared run.
input_size_counters measures UTF-8 artifact bytes and bounded evidence fragments, not token counts. Add selected documentation, schema and detailed guidance reads when evaluating actual model input.
